policy: No dataset content is distributed. WikiNER is obtained from its public repository and materialized from its official splits. For domain-shift reproduction only, Twitter text is obtained separately and filtered/reordered using the distributed post IDs.

wiki_ner.title: Turkish Wiki NER Dataset
wiki_ner.acquisition: Clone or download the upstream repository. Pass the directory containing train.conll, dev.conll, and test.conll as WIKI_SOURCE_DIR.
wiki_ner.snapshot_identity: The original experiment archive did not retain Git metadata; the source-file hashes below identify the thesis snapshot.

twitter_ner.title: SUNLP Turkish Twitter NER Dataset
twitter_ner.acquisition: For the domain-shift experiment, obtain the source annotations and permitted post text. Place train_with_tweet_text.tsv, val_with_tweet_text.tsv, and test_with_tweet_text.tsv under TWITTER_SOURCE_DIR. The public ID files select and order the domain-shift subset.
twitter_ner.snapshot_identity: The thesis used locally recovered post text. The augmented-source hashes and public post IDs identify the intended snapshot.
twitter_ner.id_scheme: Domain-shift Twitter post identifier from the source annotation.
twitter_ner.availability_warning: Deleted or changed posts can prevent exact reconstruction. Missing required IDs must be reported as a non-equivalent reproduction.
